page_text_ocr_zh:
我希望这本书能激励年轻读者追求自己的梦想，像乔丹一样：
确定目标，积极努力，全心投入，只有这样才能梦想成真。
因此，我将这本书献给那些常说“我办不到”、
“如果我有天分就好了”或“如果我有才学就好了”的孩子。
我希望他们：“你有天分，你有才学，而且你很特别，
上帝在你们每一个人身上都有安排。相信自己，追求你的梦想。”
——迪达里·乔丹

所有善良、完美的恩典都来自上帝。
我奉上所有的赞美，感谢上帝赐予我梦想、信心与成就。
我将这本书献给想要如雄鹰展翅高飞的孩子：
借着上帝的恩典，你能飞，努力去做就对了。
——罗丝琳·M.乔丹

献给我的母亲和父亲以及撒里哈、阿敏和雪迪雅
——卡迪尔·尼尔森

I hope this book will inspire young readers to pursue their dreams, just like Jordan: 
Set your goals, work hard, and give your all—only then can dreams come true. 
Therefore, I dedicate this book to those who often say “I can’t do it,” 
“If only I had talent,” or “If only I had ability.” 
I hope they know: “You have talent, you have ability, and you are special. 
God has a plan for each of you. Believe in yourself and pursue your dreams.” 
—Dedicated by Diddley Jordan

All goodness and perfect grace come from God. 
I offer all my praise, thanking God for granting me dreams, faith, and achievement. 
I dedicate this book to children who wish to soar like eagles: 
With God’s grace, you can fly. Just go for it. 
—Roslyn M. Jordan

Dedicated to my mother and father, and to Saliha, Amin, and Shadiya 
—Kadir Nelson

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
乔丹很喜欢打篮球。
每个星期六，他跟着哥哥赖瑞和罗尼去公园，希望能
跟他们一起打球。如果另一个常和他们一起打球的男孩没
来，他们就会让乔丹上场。可是，有个名叫马克的男孩总
是找乔丹麻烦，而且马克在他们之中个子又最高。

“怎么啦，小乔丹，太矮了吧？”马克在乔丹面前挥
舞着双臂。
“这里！”赖瑞高喊。乔丹想把球
传过去，马克却伸出长长的手臂把球拍
掉了。球落到其他队友手中，那个孩子
上篮得分，比赛就此结束。
page_text_en:
Jordan loved playing basketball.
Every Saturday, he followed his brothers Larry and Ronnie to the park, hoping to play with them. If another boy who usually played with them wasn't there, they would let Jordan join in. But a boy named Mark always gave Jordan trouble, and Mark was the tallest among them.

"What's wrong, little Jordan? Too short?" Mark taunted, waving his arms in front of Jordan.
"Here!" Larry shouted. Jordan tried to pass the ball, but Mark reached out with his long arms and knocked it away. The ball landed in a teammate's hands, and that kid scored a layup. The game ended there.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了乔丹在公园打篮球时被高个子男孩马克欺负的场景，马克抢断了乔丹的传球，导致队友得分并结束比赛。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
“真的很对不起。如果我长得高一点，就不会这样了。”乔丹在回家的路上不停地道歉，虽然并没有人责怪他。
哥哥罗尼安慰他：“小弟，你今天打得不错。没关系，下次我们会赢回来的。”
page_text_en:
"I'm really sorry. If I were just a little taller, this wouldn't have happened." Jordan kept apologizing on the way home, even though no one blamed him.
His brother Ronnie comforted him: "Little brother, you played well today. It's okay, we'll win it back next time."
summary_zh: 乔丹在输掉篮球比赛后感到自责，不断道歉，哥哥罗尼安慰他并鼓励他下次赢回来。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
他们回到家，乔丹走进厨房，妈妈正在准备晚餐。他还是很沮丧，妈妈一看就知道怎么了。
“你们今天输了，是吗？”
乔丹点点头。他静静地坐了一会儿，开口问妈妈：“我怎样才能长高一点儿啊？”
妈妈一般能回答很多问题，不过，今天这个问题有点儿难。她一边给晚餐要吃的烤鸡撒上盐和胡椒，一边思索。突然，她面露微笑，看着乔丹说：“盐。”
“盐？”乔丹望着妈妈。
她说：“在鞋子里放盐。每天晚上在你的鞋子里撒一些盐，然后祷告。很快，你就会长高了！”
page_text_en:
They returned home, and Jordan walked into the kitchen, where his mom was preparing dinner. He was still feeling down, and his mom knew exactly what was wrong.
"You lost today, didn't you?"
Jordan nodded. He sat quietly for a moment, then asked his mom, "How can I grow a little taller?"
Mom usually could answer many questions, but today's question was a bit tricky. As she sprinkled salt and pepper on the roasted chicken for dinner, she thought. Suddenly, she smiled and looked at Jordan, saying, "Salt."
"Salt?" Jordan looked at his mom.
She said, "Put salt in your shoes. Every night, sprinkle some salt in your shoes and then pray. Soon, you'll grow taller!"
summary_zh: 乔丹回家后向妈妈倾诉输球的沮丧，并询问如何长高，妈妈用一个充满童趣的建议——在鞋子里放盐并祷告——来安慰他。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
“鞋子里放盐？”
乔丹反复想着这句话。妈妈一定在开玩笑。他望着
窗外，想不通为什么盐能帮助他长高。

他注意到妈妈在花园里种的玫瑰花，那些五颜六色的花沿着篱笆
长得高高的。他记得那些花刚种下去的样子。乔丹的精神为之一振。
既然妈妈知道怎么让玫瑰花长高，或许她说的是真的，在我的鞋子里
撒一些盐，真的能让我长高吧！
page_text_en:
"Salt in my shoes?"
Jordan kept thinking about that. His mom must be joking. He looked out the window, wondering how salt could help him grow taller.

He noticed the roses his mom planted in the garden, those colorful flowers growing tall along the fence. He remembered how they looked when they were first planted. Jordan's spirits lifted. If Mom knew how to make roses grow tall, maybe she was right—maybe if I sprinkle some salt in my shoes, it really could help me grow taller!
summary_zh: 乔丹对妈妈提出的‘鞋子里放盐能长高’的建议感到困惑，但看到花园里高大的玫瑰花后，他开始相信这个方法可能真的有效。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
乔丹越想越兴奋，在厨房里转来转去，不停地问问题。“妈妈，长高需要多久？你想我会长到多高？
妈妈微笑着坐在旁边，向他解释：“要让这个办法有效，最重要的是你要有耐心，照我的话去做，还要每天晚上诚心祷告。”
乔丹专心听完，但还是有些疑惑地说：“好吧，妈妈，我会有耐心。可是这跟祷告有什么关系啊？”
“绝对有关。”妈妈拥抱着他说，“去洗脸洗手，叫哥哥姐姐来吃晚餐吧。”
乔丹冲出厨房，差点儿撞上正是进来的爸爸。
“他怎么了？”爸爸问。
“哦，跟平常一样……”妈妈笑着说，“追逐梦想。”
page_text_en:
Jordan became more and more excited, pacing around the kitchen and asking questions. "Mom, how long will it take to grow? How tall do you think I'll get?"
Mom smiled and sat beside him, explaining, "For this to work, the most important thing is to be patient, follow my advice, and pray sincerely every night."
Jordan listened carefully, but still felt a bit puzzled. "Okay, Mom, I'll be patient. But what does this have to do with praying?"
"It's absolutely connected," Mom said, hugging him. "Go wash your face and hands, and call your brother and sister for dinner."
Jordan rushed out of the kitchen and almost bumped into Dad, who was just coming in.
"What's wrong with him?" Dad asked.
"Oh, just like usual..." Mom said with a smile, "chasing dreams."
summary_zh: 乔丹对妈妈提出的‘鞋子里放盐能长高’的方法充满好奇，向妈妈追问细节，妈妈鼓励他要有耐心并每天祷告。乔丹虽有疑惑，但仍决定尝试。随后他兴奋地跑出厨房，差点撞到刚进门的爸爸，妈妈笑着解释说他只是在追逐梦想。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
晚餐的时候，妈妈注意到乔丹几乎什么也没吃。他沉浸在长高的幻想里。
“乔丹，该做什么就做什么。你不吃东西就不会长高，尤其是蔬菜。”妈妈说。
“可是我不饿。”他说。
妈妈扬起眉毛，严肃地看着他。
乔丹慢慢拿起叉子，一口口吃了起来。没多久，他就吃光了盘子里所有的食物，还想要更多。

睡觉前，乔丹把他最心爱的球鞋放在画有身高尺的墙边。接着他换上睡衣，做了祷告，跳上床去，进入梦乡。
page_text_en:
At dinner time, Mom noticed Jordan hadn't eaten much. He was lost in his fantasy of growing taller.
"Jordan, do what you're supposed to do. You won't grow if you don't eat, especially vegetables," Mom said.
"But I'm not hungry," he said.
Mom raised her eyebrows and looked at him seriously.
Jordan slowly picked up his fork and began eating, bite by bite. Soon, he finished all the food on his plate and wanted more.

Before bed, Jordan placed his favorite basketball shoes by the wall with the height chart. Then he put on his pajamas, said his prayers, jumped into bed, and fell asleep.
summary_zh: 乔丹在晚餐时因想长高而食欲不振，妈妈劝他吃饭后他最终吃光了食物；睡前，他将球鞋放在身高尺旁，祷告后入睡。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
妈妈进房间时，乔丹已经睡着了。她从乔丹的表情看得出来，乔丹正在梦里打篮球。
妈妈撒了一些盐在他的鞋子里，走到他身边安静地祷告，就像她为其他几个孩子做的一样。
page_text_en:
When Mom entered the room, Jordan was already asleep. From his expression, she could tell he was dreaming about playing basketball.
Mom sprinkled some salt into his shoes, walked quietly to his side, and prayed, just as she did for her other children.
summary_zh: 妈妈进入乔丹的房间，发现他已入睡，正梦见打篮球。她按照惯例，在他的鞋子里撒了些盐，并在他床边安静地祷告。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
那个晚上以后，乔丹无论去哪个地方，都穿着他最心爱的球鞋，甚至连上教堂也不例外。星期六，他不再跟着哥哥们去公园打球了，他留在家里练习，希望等长高几厘米以后，再到公园去。

“亲爱的上帝，请帮助乔丹梦想成真，让他尽最大的努力做好每一件事情。主啊！请让他明天比今天长高一点，好吗？谢谢，阿门。”
page_text_en:
After that night, Jordan wore his favorite basketball shoes wherever he went, even to church. On Saturdays, he no longer went to the park to play with his brothers; instead, he stayed home to practice, hoping that after growing a few centimeters taller, he could return to the park.

"Dear God, please help Jordan's dream come true, and let him do his best in everything. Lord, please let him be a little taller tomorrow than he is today, okay? Thank you. Amen."
summary_zh: 乔丹开始每天穿着心爱的球鞋练习篮球，并在家中独自训练，希望长高后能重返公园打球。妈妈在乔丹睡着后，为他祷告并往鞋里撒盐，祈求他长高。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
经过两个月的努力练习、耐心等待和虔诚祷告，乔丹又站在墙边量身高。可是他一点儿也没有长高。他很失望，但并没有怀疑妈妈的话。乔丹想：我一定要有耐心，就像妈妈说的一样。而他也的确这么做了。

他又努力练习了两个月，可还是没有长高。乔丹有一点儿难过，不只是因为他连一厘米也没有长高，同时也很怀念和赖瑞及罗尼一起打球的日子，这可不包括被马克找麻烦。

又到了星期六，哥哥找他一起去公园打球，他不肯。妈妈开始担心了。她看见乔丹独自坐在台阶上，便对爸爸说：‘你应该去跟他谈一谈！’
page_text_en:
After two months of hard practice, patient waiting, and sincere prayer, Jordan stood by the wall to measure his height again. But he hadn't grown at all. He was disappointed, but he didn't doubt his mother's words. Jordan thought: I must be patient, just as Mom said. And he truly did.

He practiced hard for another two months, but still didn't grow taller. Jordan felt a bit sad, not only because he hadn't grown even one centimeter, but also because he missed playing basketball with Larry and Ronnie. That didn't include being bothered by Mark.

It was Saturday again, and his brother asked him to go to the park to play basketball, but he refused. His mother began to worry. She saw Jordan sitting alone on the steps and said to his father, 'You should talk to him!'
summary_zh: 乔丹经过两个月的努力练习和祷告后身高未变，感到失望但依然坚持；周末他拒绝和哥哥去打球，妈妈看到他独自坐在台阶上，便建议爸爸去和他谈谈。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
爸爸在乔丹身边坐下。
“怎么啦，儿子？你很久没跟哥哥去公园打篮球了。你还好吗？
乔丹没吭声。过了一会儿，他看着爸爸说：‘本来以为我应该会长高几厘米的。我照着妈妈的话做了，可是什么也没有改变。’
爸爸问：‘乔丹，你为什么想长高？’
‘如果我能长高一点儿，可以把球打好，为我们球队赢球。’乔丹说。
‘可你已经是个好球员了，你具备了赢球所需要的条件，这个很重要。’爸爸在乔丹胸前轻拍了几下，‘长得高一点儿或许能让你打得更好，可更重要的是毅力、决心和尽最大的努力，这些才能使你成为真正的赢家。’
乔丹想了想爸爸的话。突然，他跳了起来，拔腿就跑。
‘你去哪里？’爸爸在他身后大喊。
‘今天有场比赛，我已经迟到了！’乔丹高声回答。
page_text_en:
Dad sat down beside Jordan.
"What's wrong, son? You haven't gone to the park to play basketball with your brother for a long time. Are you okay?"
Jordan didn't respond. After a while, he looked at his dad and said, "I thought I would grow a few centimeters. I did what Mom told me, but nothing changed."
Dad asked, "Jordan, why do you want to grow taller?"
"If I could grow a little taller, I could play better and help our team win games," Jordan said.
"But you're already a good player. You have the qualities needed to win, and that's very important," Dad said, gently patting Jordan's chest. "Being taller might help you play better, but what's more important is perseverance, determination, and giving your best effort. That's what makes a true winner."
Jordan thought about his dad's words. Suddenly, he jumped up and ran off.
"Where are you going?" Dad called after him.
"There's a game today, and I'm already late!" Jordan shouted back.
summary_zh: 爸爸发现乔丹因身高未长而情绪低落，耐心开导他，强调毅力和努力比身高更重要。乔丹深受鼓舞，立刻跑向球场参加比赛。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
乔丹到公园时，球赛已经开始了。他坐在长条椅上，希望自己也能上场。比赛接近尾声时，两队打成了平局，乔丹的队友约翰突然跌倒受伤了，不得不退出比赛。他的机会来了。

比赛暂停，乔丹的队友在场边围成一圈，乔丹也加入他们。

“好，现在平手，我们只要再得一分就够了。谁来投篮？”罗尼问大家，但他的目光投向乔丹。

乔丹感到前所未有的自信，他说：“我！”，
page_text_en:
When Jordan arrived at the park, the game had already started. He sat on the bench, hoping he could get to play. Near the end of the game, the two teams were tied, and Jordan's teammate John suddenly fell and got injured, forcing him to leave the game. His chance had come.

The game paused, and Jordan's teammates gathered in a circle on the sideline. Jordan joined them.

"Alright, it's tied now. We just need one more point. Who's going to shoot?" Roni asked everyone, but his eyes were fixed on Jordan.

Jordan felt an unprecedented confidence and said, "Me!"
summary_zh: 乔丹来到公园时比赛已开始，他坐在长椅上等待机会。比赛末段，队友受伤离场，他获得上场机会。在暂停时，队友询问谁来投篮，乔丹充满自信地主动请缨。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
植瑞从内侧把球传给乔丹。乔丹接住球，运了几下，突然加速切入。

哨声响起，比赛又开始了。马克照回来找乔丹的麻烦。乔丹不理他。不论身高如何，乔丹一直在练习，他下定决心，今天一定要赢。
page_text_en:
Zhi Rui passed the ball to Jordan from the inside. Jordan caught the ball, dribbled a few times, and suddenly accelerated into the basket.

The whistle blew, and the game resumed. Mark Zhao came back to bother Jordan. Jordan ignored him. No matter his height, Jordan had been practicing all along. He made up his mind: today, he was going to win.
summary_zh: 比赛重新开始，乔丹在队友传球后加速切入，同时面对对手的挑衅，他决心凭借练习赢得比赛。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
乔丹靠近马克时，他切到马克的右边，马克跟了过来，但乔丹趁马克的重心还在往右移动时，突然换手切到左边去。他在马克身后急停跳投，球以漂亮的弧线飞过对手的上方，无声无息地空心入网。两分！比赛结束。乔丹这一队赢了！

乔丹的梦想实现了。当他回过神来，立刻飞也似的一路跑回了家。
page_text_en:
When Jordan approached Mark, he cut to Mark's right. Mark followed, but Jordan, taking advantage of Mark's center of gravity still shifting right, suddenly switched hands and cut to the left. He stopped and jumped to shoot behind Mark, and the ball arced beautifully over the defender, dropping silently through the net. Two points! The game was over. Jordan's team had won!

Jordan's dream had come true. When he came to his senses, he ran home as fast as he could.
summary_zh: 乔丹在比赛中凭借急停跳投得分，帮助球队获胜，实现了自己的梦想，随后兴奋地跑回家。

title_zh: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹
title_en: Salt in the Shoes: Michael Jordan
source_file: 鞋子里的盐：迈克尔·乔丹（5-7 岁）- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
他冲进厨房，兴奋地大喊：“我做到了！爸爸，我做到了！我在那些比我高的人面前投篮了。我们赢了！”
赖瑞和罗尼跟着跑进来，一起欢呼庆祝。
“没错，小弟，你做到了。你赢了这场比赛。”

乔丹想起罗尼在比赛暂停时看着他的表情，他说：“不对，是我们赢了这场比赛，不过，我是最棒的。”大家都笑了。

从那天以后，妈妈不再把盐撒在乔丹的鞋子里。不过，乔丹依旧保持着耐心、努力练习和诚心祷告。
page_text_en:
He rushed into the kitchen, shouting excitedly, "I did it! Dad, I did it! I shot a basket in front of people taller than me. We won!"
Larry and Ronnie ran in after him, cheering together.
"You got it, little brother. You won the game."

Jordan remembered Ronnie's expression during the timeout. He said, "No, we won the game. But I'm the best." Everyone laughed.

From that day on, Mom stopped putting salt in Jordan's shoes. But Jordan still kept his patience, practiced hard, and prayed sincerely.
summary_zh: 乔丹在比赛中成功投篮并帮助球队获胜，兴奋地跑回家与家人分享喜悦。家人和朋友为他庆祝，乔丹也意识到团队胜利的重要性，从此妈妈不再往他的鞋里撒盐，但他依然坚持练习和祷告。
